name: Saint Helena
facts: Part of the British Overseas Territory of Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha

flag.description: A Blue Ensign with a shield in the fly: a wirebird on a yellow band at the top, above a three-masted sailing ship between two rocky cliffs.
flag.symbolism: The wirebird, or Saint Helena plover, is the island's national bird, and the ship approaching between the cliffs recalls the sailing ships that called at this remote Atlantic stop.

hook: Saint Helena's badge has a little wirebird perched on a yellow strip above a sailing ship between cliffs; the Falklands put a ram above their ship instead.
trivia: Napoleon was exiled to Saint Helena in 1815 and died there in 1821.
The wirebird on the flag is the last surviving bird species endemic to the island.
